visualInspection.findings: Inspected five Android densities: legacy tiles, circular adaptive crops and monochrome silhouettes. Leaves and tray remain within circle with visible margin; no clipped edge or duplicate background art. iOS 20/167/180/1024px examples preserve the sprout/tray silhouette; 20px internal detail naturally reduces. Solid ivory background and square iOS export edges are visible.

Inspected all eight covers: cohesive tray/plant illustration family; no visible crop of tray/foliage, text, watermark or checkerboard. These are illustrative botanical images, not independent species/content verification.
Inspected full 512px icon: centered sprout/tray, opaque ivory rectangular background, no baked rounded corners or visible clipping.

remainingBoundaries: Declared symbol presence and hash equality do not independently establish every runtime branch. Current parent-owned production-screen review supplies that complementary evidence.

Catalog originals remain absolute local generation-cache paths; accessible on this machine is not a portable source archive. No external artwork/license verification or legal/trademark clearance is asserted.
Native slot/mask/alpha inspection is file-level evidence. Android launcher variants and native iOS/App Store rendering/submission are not executed by this review.

Google Play feature graphics have size/hash inventory only in this review; they were not visually inspected here. They are separate store marketing derivatives, not counted among the 29 in-app assets.
